title: Borrow wisely
intro: Borrowing has a price. This Lesson shows how to read that price. It also shows how lenders decide what to charge you.

check.prompt: A higher APR means a loan costs less.
check.explanation: Myth. A higher APR means the loan costs more each year.

check.prompt: Nam pays his card bill late three months in a row. What happens to his credit score?
check.explanation: It goes down. Late payments are a common reason scores fall.

check.prompt: Checking your own credit score lowers it.
check.explanation: Myth. Checking your own score does not change it.
